generation.scope: Across positive-dimensional fibers as well as point graphs, the mixed-endpoint four-step determinantal correspondence has only simple cycles in every finite strongly connected subsystem, with at most four consecutive cyclic components. Every recurrent irreducible sequence of dominant correspondences is birational in both directions and has generic return multiplicity one. Different dominant returns of matched lengths agree at every intermediate point.

open_mathematics: Use a cubic slice with all three supports of dimension three to construct a ternary subalgebra and transfer all-degree regularity to a finite ternary test, targeting in particular the finite point graph of opposite rank six or seven.
